protocol: Sequential subprocess comparison of the first 16 or 32 test triples, all head/tail candidates, float32, TF32 disabled, 1 warmup, median of 3 repetitions. No changes to Flock sampling budget.
timing_limitations: Local prefix measurements, not a full-test or state-of-the-art comparison. Early exploratory probes had another GPU process present and are excluded. A shared GPU lock was acquired during the comparison campaign; pre-lock comparisons cannot exclude unobserved contention. Some CPU validation ran during the campaign.
